shellCommands.command: pwd && rg --files -g '!node_modules' | head -80 && printf '\n--- direction references ---\n' && rg -n "direction|getComputedStyle|rtl|dir=" --glob '!node_modules/**' .

find . -path './node_modules' -prune -o -type f -print | head -100; printf '\n--- direction references ---\n'; grep -RInE 'direction|getComputedStyle|rtl|dir=' --exclude-dir=node_modules --exclude-dir=.git . | head -200

sed -n '1,220p' src/components/LightboxRoot.tsx; printf '
--- RTL tests ---
'; sed -n '1,240p' test/unit/RTL.spec.ts; printf '
--- package ---
'; sed -n '1,180p' package.json; printf '
--- git status ---
'; git status --short

find src test -type f -maxdepth 5 -print | sort; printf '
--- hooks and effects ---
'; grep -RInE 'MutationObserver|useLayoutEffect|useEffect\(' src test --exclude='*.css' | head -240; printf '
--- test setup/utils ---
'; sed -n '1,260p' test/unit/test-utils.tsx; find test -maxdepth 2 -type f \( -name '*setup*' -o -name '*.ts' \) -print | sort | xargs grep -nE 'jsdom|setup|beforeEach|MutationObserver' 2>/dev/null | head -160

sed -n '1,180p' src/hooks/useLayoutEffect.ts; sed -n '1,160p' src/components/index.ts; sed -n '1,180p' src/modules/Portal.tsx; sed -n '1,180p' src/plugins/inline/InlineContainer.tsx; sed -n '1,160p' src/Lightbox.tsx; sed -n '1,180p' src/modules/Root.tsx; sed -n '1,130p' test/unit/setup.ts; sed -n '1,140p' src/contexts/RTLContext.tsx
